quality_policy: Exclude every remeasure_tasks task and require all 18 raw rounds of a shape to be eligible for the common six-condition cohort. Do not relax quality thresholds or relabel REVIEW.
selection: Compare each fixed learner/target/condition before and after augmentation on both validation cohorts. Primary recommendation is the full augmented endpoint; choose learner/target by pooled old+new validation mean MAPE across seeds, then mean p90.
